newsitem.title: FRANCE: Need to consolidate forex devts - French source.
newsitem.headline: Need to consolidate forex devts - French source.

text.p: Group of Seven (G7) nations meeting in Berlin on Saturday need to consolidate recent developments in major exchange rates, a French official source said on Thursday.
"We must consolidate this development (in world exchange rates) and reduce volatility," he told reporters.
"We believe that the current situation is more in conformity with fundamentals," he added.

Although there is no formal agenda, the source said G7 ministers were expected to talk about exchnage rates, take stock of the current economic outlook, have a read-out from European Union countries present on progress to the European single currency, and also discuss international financial stability.
They would also discuss International Monetary Fund special drawing rights (SDRs) and also competition.
